manifest.title_fil: Ipakita ang wastong paglilinis ng kamay
objectives_fil: Sa return demonstration, piliin ang angkop na paraan at ipakita ang kumpletong paglilinis ng magkabilang kamay kasama ang tamang pagpapatuyo.
objectives_en: In a return demonstration, choose the appropriate method and show complete cleaning of both hands, including correct drying.

sections.takeaway_fil: Pumili ng paraan para sa dalawang card: may dumi at walang dumi. Ipakita ang handwash at handrub sa supervisor.
sections.takeaway_en: Choose a method for two cards: visibly dirty and not visibly dirty. Demonstrate handwashing and handrub to the supervisor.

sections.takeaway_fil: Gawin ang buong paghuhugas at tamang pagpapatuyo.

check.prompt_fil: May nakikitang dumi sa kamay. Alin ang angkop?
check.prompt_en: Hands are visibly dirty. Which option fits?

options.fil: Handrub lamang kahit may nakikitang dumi.
options.en: Handrub alone despite the visible dirt.

options.fil: Tubig lamang na mabilis na ipapadaan sa kamay.
options.en: A quick rinse with water alone.
Wash with soap and water, then dry.

check.feedback_fil: 1: Kailangan ang sabon at tubig para sa nakikitang dumi. 2: Kulang ang sabon, pagkuskos sa lahat ng bahagi at pagpapatuyo. 3: Gawin ang buong paghuhugas at tamang pagpapatuyo.
check.feedback_en: 1: Visible dirt calls for soap and water. 2: Soap, all-surface rubbing and drying are missing. 3: Complete washing and appropriate drying.

sections.takeaway_fil: Patuyuin gamit ang single-use towel; kuskusin ang handrub hanggang matuyo at huwag punasan.
sections.takeaway_en: Dry with a single-use towel; rub handrub until dry and never wipe it off.

sections.takeaway_fil: Sabon at tubig kung may nakikitang dumi; hindi kapalit ng hand hygiene ang gloves.
sections.takeaway_en: Soap and water for visible dirt; gloves do not replace hand hygiene.

sections.takeaway_fil: Hayaang matuyo habang kinukumpleto ang handrub sa lahat ng bahagi.
sections.takeaway_en: Let hands dry while completing rubbing across all surfaces.

check.prompt_fil: Natatapos ang handrub pero basa pa. Ano ang gagawin?
check.prompt_en: Handrub has been applied but hands are still wet. What next?

options.fil: Punasan agad sa suot na damit para makabalik sa gawain.
options.en: Wipe it on clothing immediately to return to work.

options.fil: Banlawan sa tubig kahit wala pang buong handrub procedure.
options.en: Rinse with water before completing the handrub procedure.

check.feedback_fil: 1: Hayaang matuyo habang kinukumpleto ang handrub sa lahat ng bahagi. 2: Hindi dapat punasan ang handrub at maaaring makontamina muli. 3: Hindi bahagi ng handrub ang pagbanlaw nito.
check.feedback_en: 1: Let hands dry while completing rubbing across all surfaces. 2: Handrub should not be wiped off; hands may be recontaminated. 3: Rinsing is not part of the handrub procedure.

sections.takeaway_fil: Magpaobserba sa supervisor ng dalawang paraan gamit ang checklist.
sections.takeaway_en: Ask the supervisor to observe both methods with the checklist.

assets.alt_fil: Tatlong kahon: Piliin ang paraan, Lahat ng bahagi, Patuyuin.
assets.alt_en: Three boxes: Choose the method, Cover every surface, Dry appropriately.
assets.caption_fil: Tamang paraan; lahat ng bahagi ng magkabilang kamay; kumpletong oras at pagpapatuyo; walang muling kontaminasyon.
assets.caption_en: Appropriate method; all surfaces of both hands; complete timing and drying; no recontamination.
assets.provenance: Original bilingual vector diagram authored for Chapter 2; no source artwork reproduced.

assets.alt_fil: Walong hakbang ng handrub: 1. Maglagay ng sapat na handrub sa nakakurbang palad. 2. Kuskusin ang palad sa palad. 3. Palad sa likod ng kabilang kamay, magkasalikop ang daliri; ulitin sa kabilang kamay. 4. Palad sa palad, magkasalikop ang daliri. 5. Likod ng mga daliri sa kabilang palad, magkakawit. 6. Ikutin ang hinlalaki sa loob ng kabilang palad; ulitin sa kabilang kamay. 7. Ikutin ang dulo ng mga daliri sa kabilang palad; ulitin sa kabilang kamay. 8. Kuskusin hanggang matuyo; huwag punasan.
assets.alt_en: Eight handrub steps: 1. Apply a palmful of handrub in a cupped hand. 2. Rub palm to palm. 3. Palm over the back of the other hand, fingers interlaced; repeat on the other hand. 4. Palm to palm, fingers interlaced. 5. Backs of fingers to the opposite palm, fingers interlocked. 6. Rotate each thumb clasped in the other palm. 7. Rub the fingertips in circles on the other palm; repeat on the other hand. 8. Keep rubbing until dry; do not wipe.
assets.caption_fil: Handrub, 20–30 segundo: parehong mga bahagi ng magkabilang kamay, hanggang matuyo. May pagsasalaysay at caption ang video; mas mahaba ito kaysa sa totoong handrub.
assets.caption_en: Handrub, 20–30 seconds: the same surfaces on both hands, until dry. The video is narrated and captioned; it runs longer than a real handrub.
assets.provenance: Original bilingual schematic animation rendered with Remotion from remotion/src/hand-hygiene (INC-28 tier 2); step order follows the cited WHO handrub procedure; no source artwork reproduced. Narration: owner-approved script (remotion/src/hand-hygiene/narration.ts) synthesized with Gemini TTS (voice Kore), one render per language, captions from the same timings.
